solver_contract: Shared native solver is generated by the active longitudinal MPC with terminal speed, acceleration and distance constraints; stock runtime applies its unchanged constraint penalties at all N+1 stages

plannerd.py.adaptation: Redirected planner imports and connected independent conditional mode and shared SLC through bounded event transport and a shared status publisher. BOSCH-A HOOK: none (owner 2026-11-13: no toggles); LongitudinalPlanner(CP) builds the Bosch-A parts, each gated by bosch_a_toggles (long_tuning_active, or vehicle_supported for HumanFollowing/HumanAcceleration and release smoothing)

planner.py.adaptation: Redirected MPC imports and applied the optional, authority-checked SLC cap to the cruise target. On a car that fails bosch_a_toggles.long_tuning_active the Bosch-A hooks add nothing, except ACCEL BOOST below. BOSCH-A HOOK 1/3 (__init__): arms HumanFollowing/HumanAcceleration and the Stock Brake Feel enhancement (brake onset ramp inside its step()) with no toggle (owner 2026-11-13), each only on a verified Bosch-A Honda with openpilot longitudinal (Stock Brake Feel needs the radar on; HumanFollowing/HumanAcceleration also run vision-only; lazy imports). HOOK 2/3 (before mpc.update): model lead paths, and the HumanAcceleration cap in relaxed/standard personality only (human_acceleration.applies), passed to the MPC. HOOK 3/3 (after output_should_stop, before the final clip): min with the HumanAcceleration cap when it was set for this personality, then honda_bosch_a_long step() (build rate / onset ramp on the final target; lead() applies the Stock Brake Feel depth cap to the MPC lead candidate only, before min(candidates), 2026-11-15) BOSCH-A SMOOTH: bosch_a_release.BoschARelease.smooth (Bosch-A Hondas, radar on or off, always on) shortens action_t to min(0.30, delay+DT_MDL) and applies a brake release limit + 2-tick dwell to output_a_target before the final clip. BOSCH-A STOP GAP: bosch_a_stop_gap.BoschAStopGap (Bosch-A Hondas with the radar, always on) then holds shouldStop behind a stopped radar lead and caps the target at -0.25 while crawling inside the 6 m stop gap; it only adds braking. STOCK BRAKE FEEL ENGAGE INIT (47efdc1dc8): get_cruise_accel(..., jerk_limit=True) keyword; with Stock Brake Feel on, on reset_state a_cruise is seeded with min(a_cruise, unjerk-limited cruise target). ACCEL BOOST (629e010525, all cars; its lead gate only on Bosch-A Hondas with the radar on: AccelBoost(lead_gate=long_tuning_active(CP))): AccelBoost (selfdrive/controls/lib/accel_boost.py, commaai/openpilot#39015) adds up to +0.2 m/s^2 to the e2e target in Experimental Mode after a gas press while the model is the slowest source; published as longitudinalPlan.accelBoost. CURVE SLOWDOWN HOOK: curve_speed.CurveSpeed from commaai/openpilot#39307 (byte-identical selfdrive/controls/lib/curve_speed.py) adds up to -0.5 m/s^2 (0.5 m/s^3 ramp) to the e2e target when the model path within 6 s reaches 2.8 m/s^2 lateral acceleration; reset with the planner state; the StarPilot planner does not use it.

mpc.py.adaptation: Stock tuning and planner arithmetic unchanged; apply stock slack penalties at terminal stage for the shared constrained native solver. BOSCH-A HOOKs (keyword-only update args, default None = stock): lead_paths replaces a lead's raw extrapolation; acceleration_max replaces ACCEL_MAX only if finite and within [0, ACCEL_MAX]
